newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures dip in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures dip in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were lower across the board on Wednesday, partly due to a view that domestic rubber stocks will start rising from next year, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.8 yen to 1.5 yen per kilogram lower than the day's close. The benchmark May contract was down 1.5 yen at 142.5 yen. Volume was 6,727 lots.

Prices were firmer earlier in the day, backed by the yen's fall against the dollar, but trade house selling gained momentum later and offset buying by private investors, they said. --Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-7431
